description:
PetPulse: Global pet health and care intelligence API. AI-synthesized veterinary symptom triage, breed selection guides, pet nutrition analysis, medication safety (drug interactions, toxin exposure), senior pet

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • symptoms ($0.10): Symptom triage
  • research ($0.10): Veterinary research synthesis
  • nutrition ($0.10): Condition-based nutrition guidance
  • medication ($0.08): Veterinary drug reference
  • breed ($0.08): Breed health and care guide
  • cost ($0.08): Vet procedure cost estimator
  • insurance ($0.10): Pet insurance comparison
  • senior ($0.10): Senior pet care
  • toxin ($0.10): Pet toxicity assessment
  • travel ($0.08): Pet travel guide
  • behavior ($0.10): Pet behavior and training guide
  • recall-check ($0.10): Pet food recall check

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: symptoms | research | nutrition | medication | breed | cost | insurance | senior | toxin | travel | behavior | recall-check

issue.description: Behavior issue (e.g. separation-anxiety, leash-reactivity, litter-box-avoidance, destructive-chewing, aggression)

product.description: Pet food brand or product name to check

name: petpulse
